mechanism: Both drugs are hepatotoxic and can cause hyperuricemia; primaquine causes hemolysis in G6PD-deficient patients which may be exacerbated by pyrazinamide-induced hyperuricemia leading to acute kidney injury.
action: Monitor liver function tests, uric acid levels, renal function, and CBC regularly; screen for G6PD deficiency before primaquine use; ensure adequate hydration; consider allopurinol if hyperuricemia develops.
